chunks: Ahmad ibn Ali said: And this report has been narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali al-Ja'fari and Abdullah ibn Hasan ibn Bashr al-Khazzaz and others, and it is well-known among them.

key_terms.الْخَزَّازُ: the coppersmith (a kunya/nisba used for identification)

ai.seo_question: Who are the other narrators of the report about seeing the Imam of the Time?
ai.summary: Ahmad ibn Ali highlights the widespread acceptance (shuhra) of this report by citing transmissions from prominent figures like Muhammad ibn Ali al-Ja'fari and Abdullah ibn al-Hasan al-Khazzaz, reinforcing its reliability within the Shia scholarly tradition. This multiplicity of chains (tawatur) underscores the certainty believers can place in the physical sightings of the Imam of the Time (a.s.) during the Minor and Major Ghaiba. Such narrations serve as crucial evidence for the doctrine of the Imam's continued presence and visibility despite his occultation.
